info.title: Tawasol al Nukhba Partner API
info.description: Dynamic published catalog managed centrally in Tawasol al Nukhba. Treat catalog.version as an opaque string. Cache catalog display for at most cache_ttl_seconds; use fresh server quotes for purchases. Package IDs, HMAC and checkout remain compatible. All partner money fields are integer halalas.

servers.description: Production API; server-side partner credentials required

post.summary: Create one order atomically from a quote

get.summary: Customer scoped orders, 20 per zero-based page
Order details, current content and short-lived private file links

post.summary: Create or reuse a scoped central checkout session
Reserve private upload; idempotent by request and key
Verify uploaded object type and size
Approve or request changes to an exact content revision
Replace full news text after an information request
Cancel an unpaid order without an active payment session

get.summary: Download the original central paid service invoice as PDF
get.description: Signed server-to-server download. Requires matching partner and customer ownership and confirmed payment. Refunded paid orders retain their original invoice. No public URL or Tawasol browser session. Success is binary PDF; errors retain the standard JSON envelope.

200.description: Original central invoice PDF; private, no-store

409.description: INVOICE_NOT_AVAILABLE: no confirmed paid positive amount

get.summary: Read current order and financial states without modifying them

200.description: Owner-only current states; private server-signed read, no-store

HmacSignature.name: X-Signature
HmacSignature.description: hex HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical request; signing key stays server-side
